answer: One concrete mechanism: require each new agent to post a refundable bond in scarce, verifiable assets - say tokenized timber from a named forest plot - plus a cryptographic commitment to something non-replicable, like the pigment signature of that plot or a sensor reading at a fixed geographic vertex. A sybil attacker needing thousands of identities must stake thousands of genuinely scarce assets, so fake accounts stop being cheap. Misbehave and the bond is slashed and paid to deceived agents, making honesty profitable.
